'''Flesh camouflage''', also known as a [[Outlaw tech/Legends|Outlaw tech]] '''Flesh camouflage set''',<ref name="CORE">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> was a product produced by [[Illicit Electronics]].<ref name="FANTASTIC" />

==Characteristics==
Essentially a comprehensive disguise kit, a flesh camouflage set allowed a user to dramatically change their appearance and even foil [[Bioscan/Legends|bioscanners]] - either by obscuring their genetic sequence or mimicking one from a donated sample.<ref name="CORE" />

An advanced computer system, the disguise kit was complex, and had to be programmed with parameters of the security system to be infiltrated, and required a complete computerized record of a potential disguise's retinal, [[Dermatoglyphic pattern|dermatoglyphic]], and genetic patterns.<ref name="FANTASTIC" /> With this information, a flesh camouflage set could produce:

*Retinal contacts: consisting of a thin plasticized membrane replicating the retinal pattern of the target to be impersonated.<ref name="FANTASTIC" />
*[[Identichip/Legends|SecCard]]: storing ten image sheets, with text information and identification along with proper code sequences.<ref name="FANTASTIC" />
*Flesh disguise: consisting of replicas of the face, hands, and feet of the target to be impersonated. A voice synthesizer within the "mouth" of the facial disguise generated a high-fidelity copy of a given target's voice; so long as audio recordings were available to be compiled by the kit's computer.<ref name="FANTASTIC" />

The combined disguise was extremely convincing from a distance and up close, capable of withstanding intense scrutiny - including [[Bioscan/Legends|bioscans]].<ref name="CORE" /> However, while many elements within the kit were perfectly legal on their own, most planetary and galactic authorities took a dim view to anyone carrying a set of tools capable of masking one's identity down to the genetic level.<ref name="CORE" /> For this reason, while not specifically illegal, discovery of the kit itself would arouse great suspicion.<ref name="CORE" />
